The scent of fresh bread wafts from the nearby baker's stall, mingling with the earthy aroma of the soil from the nearby gardens. Wren and Ash stand amidst the crowd, their eyes meeting as they both attempt to communicate, each leaning in to share their thoughts on the mysteries of the sea. Ash nods, their expression thoughtful as they consider Wren's words. They turn the conversation towards the recent events, "The distress call from the rocky islets, it's as if the sea is calling out to us, demanding our attention."
